entities.name: Aristide's Second Fall and MINUSTAH
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Aristide was re-elected in 2000 amid controversy and ousted again in February 2004 amid armed rebellion. The UN Stabilization Mission in Haiti (MINUSTAH) deployed to maintain order but was itself plagued by scandals.
